body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> YuKyung Technologies (President Sam Sik Kim, www.myviliv.com) announced the launch of its new PMP ‘X70 VANT’ during CES 2008.

As a 7-inch(17.8 cm) multimedia device, the X70 VANT is capable of using wireless internet with its built-in WLAN and exclusive web browser ‘Fast Web’ reducing size of any web pages to be fitted with it and opened quickly. Playback of T-DMB, DVD and mp3 is also available.

Compared to the 128MB other mobile multimedia devices have, the X70 VANT’s powerful 256MB memory facilitates speed, making computing and internet surfing more efficient. It has a removable big battery making a continuous 6-hour movie playback possible.

By adopting RMI Alchemy Au1250 700Mhz CPU, it boasts fast response speed and enhanced multitasking ability. Offered in two types of 30GB and 60GB, it allows users to extend its memory capacity by using SD/SDHC card.

The X70 VANT comes with mobile flash 3.0 that supports FLV files playback, enabling users to enjoy their UCCs on it. The product also offers various video files such as Divx/MPEG1,2,3/Xvid/WMV7/8/9, making you enjoy most of the existing video files without separated coding process.

“X70 VANT can be utilized simultaneously as a navigation device while you are driving and a portable multimedia player while you are on the move. By adopting home network applications in the future, its usage could be extended even more,” said the company.
